lyrics:
[Intro: soft piano, warm pad]

[Verse 1: gentle female voice]
I said your name tonight
Out loud, in the dark, by the bed
Said it slow, said it twice
Said some things I've never said

I told him how you take your coffee
How you hum when you're afraid
How you've been so tired lately
I said your name, and stayed

[Chorus: strings rise]
I said your name tonight
To the one who hung the stars
I don't have the words to fix it
But I know whose hands you're in, and whose we are
I can't carry you. He can.
So I said your name tonight

[Verse 2: voice a little stronger]
He knows what a fever is
He's touched a hand and watched it leave
He's stopped a funeral in the street
And told a mother not to grieve

He's had friends who couldn't stay awake
To pray with him one night
So I stayed up. I said your name.
To Jesus. Till the light.

[Chorus: strings and soft drums]
I said your name tonight
To the one who hung the stars
I don't have the words to fix it
But I know whose hands you're in, and whose we are
I can't carry you. He can.
So I said your name tonight

[Bridge: choir enters, building]
Healing, if he will, and I'm asking that he will
Peace, if it's a while. Him beside you, still.
Your name. I said it. Your name. Again.
Your name. He knows it. Amen.

[Final Chorus: full choir, then just her]
I said your name tonight
To the one who hung the stars
I don't have the words to fix it
But I know whose hands you're in, and whose we are
I can't carry you. He can.
So I said your name tonight

[Outro: piano, whispered]
And for me, too.
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 68 BPM, 4/4, C major. A slow, tender ballad that lifts gently into gospel and comes back down.

VOICE: Female soprano, soft, clear and young, almost speaking the first verse. She grows stronger without ever belting. A choir joins in the bridge and the last chorus, then drops away so that she ends alone, in a whisper.

INSTRUMENTS: Piano, a warm synth pad, a string quartet from the first chorus, soft mallet-like drums and a deep kick from the second chorus, bass, a gospel choir, a single acoustic guitar.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro piano. 0:12 Verse 1. 0:54 Chorus 1, strings. 1:28 Verse 2. 2:10 Chorus 2. 2:42 Bridge, choir. 3:04 Final chorus, ending with her alone. 3:30 Outro, piano and the whisper at 3:36.

PRODUCTION & MIX: Modern pop ballad with gospel warmth: voice very close, piano soft, strings and choir wide but never loud.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: 'I can't carry you. He can.' at 1:18.

THE REVEAL: Verse 1 sounds like a woman speaking a lover's name in the dark; the 'him' in its fifth line is the first clue. The chorus at 0:54 says she was praying. Verse 2 recalls Peter's mother-in-law, the widow's son at Nain and Gethsemane, and names Jesus at 1:56.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Helpless, entrusting, steady, included.
